lore.revoked_registry_tide: All that's left in the chest is half a page of the register, its ink washed grey by the tide. The name on that line has been struck out by the Scriptorium; in the margin there's only the rubbing of a salvage bell — someone rang it over and over in the fog, waiting for a person who could never be written back.
lore.revoked_registry_tide.source: Echoes of Fog Wharf: the sunken chest

nodes.T-1.edges.0.label: Follow the bell through the fog
nodes.T-1.summary: The marks on the tide chart glimmer in the fog. You follow them to the abandoned Fog Wharf — deep in the mist the salvage bell rings three times, as if someone were counting your steps.
nodes.T-1.title: Night Search at Fog Wharf
nodes.T-2.edges.0.label: Drive off the ambush and haul up the chest
nodes.T-2.summary: The grapple bites into a chest on the seabed. The moment it breaks the surface, shapes lunge out of the fog — an Ink Fiend leading its imps, guarding the chest for the Scriptorium.
nodes.T-2.title: The Salvage Battle
nodes.T-3.edges.0.label: Close the register
nodes.T-3.summary: There's no gold in the chest, only a register swollen with seawater. The struck-out names still look freshly inked — and one page bears the Salvage Guild's seal. You tuck the scrap into your codex.
nodes.T-3.title: Register of the Revoked · A Scrap
nodes.T-4.edges.0.label: Return to the Free City Plaza
nodes.T-4.summary: The fog lifts. The salvage bell falls silent. You walk back the way you came to the plaza — the marks on the tide chart have gone dark, like an errand finished.
nodes.T-4.title: The Echo Settles
